title: MCP tool invocation record
description: One line of mcp/audit/tool-invocations.jsonl. `args_hash` is a sha256 over the canonicalised arguments; raw arguments are never recorded, because they routinely carry tenant identifiers and occasionally credential references.

ts.description: UTC, ISO-8601 with a trailing Z.

agent.description: Participant id of the calling agent, or 'operator' for interactive callers.

tenant_id.description: Tenant resolved from the X-Tenant-Id header after validation against the auth claim. Never taken from the argument payload.

tool.description: Tool name. Must appear in mcp/policies/tool-allowlist.yaml for a result other than 'denied'.

args_hash.description: sha256 of the canonicalised argument object. Replaces the arguments themselves.

error_code.description: Populated for denied, error and throttled results. Free text otherwise empty.
